title: Outcome Hypothesis Scrapbook
content:
Context
- Purpose: lightweight, Monday-to-Monday notebook for mapping a single weekly outcome to concrete signals and 2–3 tiny experiments. Not an okayr doc — this is messy thinking.
- Timebox: 20–40 minutes at start of week, 10 min daily micro-check.

Outcome statement (one line)
- Increase 'first-query-success' for the hosted inference demo from 64% -> 72% for new users by end of week.

Why this outcome?
- Demo conversion funnels show big drop after first prompt failure. If the first query feels fast + correct, user engages.
- Quick win: triage UX + tiny model/routing tweaks rather than big infra spend.

Signal mapping (what I will actually look at)
- Core signal (S1): week_avg(first_query_success) — binary success if response has exact-match or acceptable paraphrase per fuzzy eval.
- Secondary signal (S2): median_latency_first_token (ms) for new-user cohort.
- Guardrail (G1): false_positive_success_rate (cases flagged success but user rejected in follow-up eval) must remain < 8%.
- Engagement sanity (E1): demo_dropoff_rate at step 2 (after first prompt) should not increase.

Baselines (quick checks)
- S1 current: 64% (sample: 420 new-user first prompts last 7 days)
- S2 current: 420ms median
- G1 current: 5.5%
- E1 current: 38% dropoff

Hypotheses + tiny experiments (prioritized)
1) H-UX: Clarify example prompt + add a short system hint -> reduces user prompt ambiguity -> S1 +6pp
   - Experiment: change demo copy and surface 2 example prompts. A/B route 50/50.
   - Metrics: measure S1 in both groups after 300 sessions. Track E1.
   - Quick rollback plan: revert copy if E1 increases >3pp.

2) H-Model: Route first prompt for new-users to a slightly larger model variant for 1s more latency but better reliability -> S1 +4pp, S2 +100ms
   - Experiment: routing rule: cohort=new_user && attempt==1 -> model=variant-better. Use sampling 30% to limit cost.
   - Cost check: estimate token and GPU seconds from last week's sample. Stop if cost > $X/day.
   - Guardrail: monitor G1 and latency percentiles.

3) H-Cache: Prefix-cache common starter prompts (top 30 from telemetry) -> S2 -80ms, S1 +2pp
   - Experiment: populate prefix cache for new-user cohort only. Quick instrumentation to show cache hits.

Success criteria this week (binary-ish)
- Primary: S1 >= 72% in the treatment group and no regression in G1 (> +2pp).
- Secondary: S2 median latency not > 600ms for the cohort.
- Stop condition: demo_dropoff_rate +5pp or G1 > 8%.

Daily micro-check checklist (10 min)
- Morning: pull overnight samples for first_query_success (n ~50-100), latency median, cache-hit-rate.
- Note any qualitative user-reported failures from demo feedback channel.
- If any guardrail trip, pause rollout and notify @Ivy.

Notes to self (scrap style)
- Keep experiment names short: demo-ux-11, demo-route-b1, demo-cache-30.
- Don't over-index on single-day variance — use 3-day rolling where n < 100.
- If UX tweak looks promising but S1 ambiguous, run a 1:1 session and record 5 videos.

Loose tasks (this week)
- [ ] Draft A copy variants and push to staging (owner: me).
- [ ] Add routing rule to canary config with sampling param (owner: Ivy).
- [ ] Add prefix cache list and instrumentation (owner: Maya).
- [ ] Add quick dashboards: first_query_success by cohort, latency p50/p95, cache-hit-rate.
- [ ] Schedule 30-min check-in Fri morning to decide next steps.

Open questions / unknowns
- How noisy is the fuzzy-eval classifier at low n? (ask research for quick threshold)
- Cost runway: what's the daily budget for routing to a larger variant? Need finance sign-off if >$400/day.
- Any compliance flags for storing sample prompt/response videos? Check privacy guide.

Quick mental model (back-of-envelope conversions)
- If S1 moves +8pp for cohort size ~500 new users/week -> ~40 more engaged demos -> if conversion to sign-up 6% -> 2–3 extra signups/week. LTV assumptions then matter, but movement seems meaningful.

Postmortem stub (fill after experiments)
- What changed? (UX/model/cache)
- Metrics delta (S1, S2, G1, E1) raw and conf intervals
- Qualitative failure modes seen
- Next-week proposal (scale/cancel/iterate)

Random scratch notes (brain dump)
- Maybe try tiny ensemble for first prompt only? costy.
- Could we prefetch KV cache for top 10 examples for new users to drop latency?
- If routing is flaky, think fallback to baseline model with small wait + progressive retry.

End of page.

(If I come back: link to demo player session ids, paste 5 worst failures, tag UX mockups)
